svg.title: pos-temperature
svg.desc: Left, toy: one key 3 logits above n - 1 equal keys. Plain softmax top weight falls from 0.019 at 1K keys to 2e-6 at 10M; Llama 4 temperature slows the fall; SSMax with s ln n keeps it near 0.8. Right, real configs: the Llama 4 query multiplier 1 + 0.1 ln(1 + floor((t+1)/8192)) is 1.07 at 8K, 1.28 at 128K, 1.49 at 1M and 1.72 at 10M; YaRN applies a constant logit multiplier of 1.81 (gpt-oss, s = 32) or 1.87 (DeepSeek-V3, s = 40).
